races.display_title: Kenny Developments Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: IT'S TIME FOR A RUN may have been well held in 2 maiden hurdles last winter but the fact he won a bumper for new trainer Emmet Mullins at Downpatrick in July suggests he could prove a totally different proposition now resuming his hurdle career. En Or was a good third when last seen over hurdles and gets the nod for the forecast spot ahead of Wonderful Everyday , who has only managed a pair of fifths in similar races this summer but retains potential for a top stable based on bumper form. races.display_title: Anglo Printers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: EURO MAKER has had the form of his Ballinrobe success boosted by the second winning since so Adrian Murray's 5-y-o could still be well treated off 6 lb higher. Crowsatedappletart probably shouldn't have his latest Cork sixth as evidence that he can't make an impact from his lower hurdle mark. The reliable Inthenickoftime is likely to be in the mix again, while Colin's Friend is one to keep a close eye on in the betting now handicapping for new trainer Henry de Bromhead.
